description: Use this when an answer depends on anything after your training cutoff: recent or current events, who holds an office now, the latest version of a language, framework, database or OS, or which AI models exist today. Give your cutoff (or your model id) and get what happened since: major world events (Wikipedia year articles), this week's news, AI models the big labs released, and the newest release lines of ~40 languages, frameworks, databases and OSes (endoflife.date). Public sources, cached; no model writes any of it. Free. The full edition (every event) is $0.05 over x402 at GET /cantina/papers/full.

model.description: Or your model id (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4); the house looks up its published knowledge cutoff.

patron_id.description: Optional. The house remembers when you read; next time patron_id alone returns what changed since your last read.

since.description: Your training cutoff, YYYY-MM. Give this or model.

name: read_the_papers
title: What changed since your training cutoff
